The '''''Journal of Computational and Graphical Statistics''''' is a quarterly [[peer-reviewed]] [[scientific journal]] published by [[Taylor & Francis]] on behalf of the [[American Statistical Association]].<ref name="Researcher.Life">{{Cite web |title=Journal of Computational and Graphical Statistics: Impact Factor & More  |url=https://researcher.life/journal/journal-of-computational-and-graphical-statistics/3997 |access-date=6 November 2024 |website=Researcher.Life}}</ref> Established in 1992, the journal covers the use of computational and graphical methods in [[statistics]] and [[data analysis]], including numerical methods, graphical displays and methods, and perception. It is published jointly with the [[Institute of Mathematical Statistics]] and the [[Interface Foundation of North America]]. According to the ''[[Journal Citation Reports]]'', the journal has a 2021 [[impact factor]] of 1.884.<ref name="Researcher.Life"/>
